Material Icon Theme
===================

Vendored third-party assets. Not Atlas code.

  Upstream : https://github.com/material-extensions/vscode-material-icon-theme
  Source   : https://open-vsx.org/extension/PKief/material-icon-theme
  Artifact : PKief.material-icon-theme-5.38.1.vsix
  Version  : 5.38.1
  Licence  : MIT — see LICENSE.txt, which travels with these files
  Vendored : 2026-09-18

Why it is here
--------------
Decision 12 of the theme-system spec bundles Material Icon Theme as Atlas's
default icon theme. It is MIT, so it may be redistributed inside Atlas (itself
MIT) as long as the copyright notice and licence text go with it — which is
what LICENSE.txt in this directory is for, and what
`tests/vendor-licensing.test.ts` checks. vscode-icons is deliberately NOT
bundled: its icons are CC BY-SA, which Atlas cannot redistribute on the same
terms.

What was taken, and what was not
--------------------------------
  dist/material-icons.json   the icon theme document, verbatim
  icons/*.svg                1251 icon files, verbatim
  LICENSE.txt                verbatim
  package.json               TRIMMED — only the fields Atlas reads, plus the
                             `contributes.iconThemes` entry that names the
                             theme document. The rest of the manifest describes
                             a VS Code extension Atlas never runs.

Dropped: the compiled extension host (`dist/extension/**`), the localisation
bundles, the logo, the changelog and the readme. None of them are icons.

Do not hand-edit anything in this directory. To update, download the newer
`.vsix` from Open VSX and re-extract the four entries above, then re-run
`cargo test -p atlas-icon-theme`.
